about: Raw values the viewer CSS may keep outside tokens.css (test_viewer_raw_css.py, docs/handbook/viewer.md §리터럴 예외). Every entry names its file, selector, property and the raw value, with the reason no token fits. A new entry needs a reason; an entry that no longer matches a declaration fails the test.

hairline.reason: Hairlines and optical corrections in padding, margin and gap: a badge's 1px above and below, a segmented control's 2px between segments, a border's 1px taken off an edge. They are the width of a line, not a spacing step.

entries.reason: An event line starts where a post's text does: the thread avatar's 20px plus its 8px gap.
A text field's height in lines of its own text (two lines), so it follows the touch text size.
A text field's height in lines of its own text (three lines), so it follows the touch text size.
Centres the chip on its row's first text line, whose line box is 1.5em.
The reason line starts under its row's label: the row's 16px leading icon plus the spacing tokens around it.
A collapsed card's head lets its 44px hit boxes overlap the card's padding above and the preview below, so the head draws 32px tall.
On touch the head's 44px controls carry that overlap themselves, so the row's own box is the 32px it draws and the blocks under it start on the grid.
